data.summary: PMO and Project Management professional with 13+ years of experience across project governance, operations management, process transformation, stakeholder management, resource planning and executive reporting. Proven experience across Tata Consultancy Services and Kumaran Systems delivering process migration, KPI/MIS reporting, billing and invoicing, governance and operational improvements for banking and card operations. Experienced in coordinating project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, actions, resource forecasting, stakeholder reporting and process standardization. Skilled in Jira, ServiceNow, Power BI and Excel/VBA, with Six Sigma Green Belt certification and hands-on exposure to banking and card operations.

Candidate's residential location or work city.

raw_sections.experience:
Assistant Manager | PMO & Project Management | Banking 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager Kumaran Systems | Jun 2024 – Aug 2026 | Client: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC)
Drive PMO governance and project coordination across planning, execution tracking, resource allocation, milestones and delivery
reviews.
Prepare KPI dashboards, MIS and executive reports to provide management with visibility into project health, productivity and
delivery performance.
Coordinate risks, issues, dependencies, action items and escalations across cross-functional project stakeholders.
Support resource planning and forecasting, including allocation tracking and capacity requirements across project teams.
Drive process improvement, automation and standardization initiatives to improve operational efficiency and governance.
Manage project documentation including Statements of Work (SOWs), project trackers, governance reports and status updates.
Manage Cards Payments operations for Bank of Montreal, supporting North American and Canadian regions.
Oversaw and led a team of 25+ associates, ensuring optimal performance and operational execution.
Monitored process adherence and implemented process discipline to improve service delivery and SLA compliance.
Work with business and delivery stakeholders to improve project visibility, accountability and execution discipline using Jira,
ServiceNow and Excel/VBA.
Assistant Manager Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Aug 2023 – Apr 2024 | Client: Citi Bank / Bank of Montreal
Nagarajan S B | PMO & Project Management | Banking & Card Operations
• Oversaw operations for 2+ Team Leaders, ensuring adherence to processes, operational continuity and high delivery performance.
Managed monthly project billing and invoicing activities, including estimates, invoices, payment schedules and follow-up on
outstanding payments.
Consolidated resource inputs to improve resource utilization, financial tracking and reporting accuracy.
Prepared and presented monthly, quarterly and annual business-review reports for senior management, clients and stakeholders.
Calculated and analyzed revenue reports, developed forecasting strategies and created revenue dashboards for business divisions.
Developed detailed project plans covering timelines, milestones and deliverables, and monitored progress against objectives.
Drafted Statements of Work (SOWs) and facilitated stakeholder approvals to align project requirements and deliverables.
Supported contract management including drafting, renewals and extensions for projects across the division.
Drove process improvement initiatives across project execution to enhance operational efficiency.
Coordinated internal, vendor and quarterly RCSA audits, including artifact collation and presentations.
Implemented AI technologies to address operational challenges and improve workflow efficiency.
Prepared and presented stakeholder decks on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis for clients and senior management.
Shift Team Leader Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Jul 2019 – Jul 2023
Led day-to-day banking operations, ensuring adherence to SLA, quality and productivity targets.
Managed team performance through KPI tracking, coaching and operational planning.
Coordinated with stakeholders to resolve operational escalations and service issues.
Supported process migration, transition and knowledge-transfer activities to enable operational continuity.
Performed root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and implemented corrective measures.
Prepared and reviewed MIS and KPI reports to support operational decision-making.
SME Lead Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | May 2017 – Jun 2019
Acted as Subject Matter Expert for banking and card operation processes, providing process guidance and operational support.
Led training and knowledge-management initiatives to onboard and upskill team members.
Maintained and updated SOPs, process documentation and knowledge resources.
Participated in process migration and transition activities to ensure continuity.
Supported quality assurance and compliance for assigned processes.
Associate Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Oct 2013 – Apr 2017
Managed daily banking and credit card operations, ensuring adherence to established procedures and SLAs.
Executed payment processing, settlement and recovery-related activities.
Reviewed transaction data and investigated discrepancies for prompt resolution.
Maintained operational records and contributed to process reporting.
Trainee Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Oct 2013 – Sep 2014
Completed structured training in banking and credit card operations, building foundational knowledge of workflows and transaction
processing.
Supported daily operational activities while meeting SLA and quality standards.
SELECTED BANKING & CARD OPERATIONS PROJECTS
Cards Payments Operations Bank of Montreal | 48 months
Managed Cards Payments operations supporting North American and Canadian regions.
Oversaw a team of 25+ associates, ensuring operational execution, process adherence and SLA compliance.
• Worked with business and delivery stakeholders to improve project visibility, accountability and execution discipline.
Nagarajan S B | PMO & Project Management | Banking & Card Operations
Card Repayment / Refund Operations Citi Bank | 26 months
Supported card repayment and refund operations, ensuring SLA adherence and quality assurance.
Logged customer complaints, managed escalations and compiled MIS reports to track performance.
Collection Back Office TCS | 42 months
Supported recovery and collections operations for delinquent credit-card accounts, including payment plans and settlement
programs.
Executed account recovery activities while ensuring compliance and maintaining positive customer interactions.
KEY CONTRIBUTIONS • Led billing, forecasting and dashboard initiatives; supported successful completion of internal and vendor audits; contributed to
process improvements and AI-driven optimizations.
Led revenue forecasting and billing dashboard initiatives used for quarterly and annual business reviews.
Supported audit readiness by collating artifacts for internal and vendor audits.
Drove process improvement initiatives at multiple stages of project execution to enhance overall efficiency.
Implemented AI technologies to resolve operational challenges and boost workflow efficiency.
